name: Kami (Hyōgo, Japan, –2005)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kami town emblem in white: a stylised device of two facing curved strokes enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Flag of the former town of Kami in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-11-01.

features.role: Kami town emblem — a stylised device of two facing curved strokes enclosing a stylised letter M
